items.description: The free Website Traffic Estimator is designed to quickly discover how many people visit a specific website on a monthly basis. In addition this tools shows you how many pages an average user views during a single session and the average bounce rate. Research and compare your competitors to find out how many monthly visitors they attract.
This plugin allows you to validate form fields values populated in Wordpress sites against the uProc service, getting data when the form is submitted.

This platform extracts the raw IATI data published by the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs from the IATI registry, and presents it in an easy-to-use web interface. It does not alter or interpret the data in any way. At this transparency portal you can find every development cooperation activity supported by the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs since 2010. The portal enables you to find the activities in specific countries or regions, in sectors or by receiver organization.
Yellow pages for Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
Using two TouTube players, DB, Ajax and PHP logic to create a radio experience. Includes breaks, jingles and comments via the Youtube data API.
See live UK travel news and alerts from the BBC on a Google Map.
Wiki and mapping site allowing scuba divers to share their favorite dive sites and advice. Good interface.
A realtime map of Northern Lights locations and photos. See the current aurora forecast and latest Flickr and Twitter posts related to the Aurora Borealis.

This is an application that allows you send SMS within the US using your Android phone via cloud service provided by Twilio. Saves money for people who don't use SMS often; pay only 2c per message when you use Twilio to send or receive SMS. The current version also provides you a way to receive SMS sent to your Twilio number via email.
Lets you receive weather updates over the phone. You have access to weather forecasts, temperature atmospheric conditions, wind, sunrise and sunset times and the ability to receive automatic updates.

Customize a UK road trip, choose stop off points along the way - restaurants, cafes, petrol stations, child friendly venues - and also has an avoid motorways function. The route can be emailed and printed.

A demo site built to show the ease of implementing BeenVerified with IPaper. IPaper was used to display resumes, and the BeenVerified API was used to demo the OAuth process of displaying verified user data.
Site that aggregates videos of watches by brand.
Play free online flash games; sports, physics, dress up, puzzle, action, arcade, multiplayer, shooting, girl, strategy games and more. Gametator.com also produces its own exclusive games.
OneStop TripOnline is an online booking company that offers access to information on different traveling-related services such as holiday packages, bus, rail and flight.
Allows Box.net users to share content on their LinkedIn profiles. They can choose which files in their Box accounts are visible to LinkedIn contacts.
Android app that lets you discover music bands and artists similar to your favorites. Integrates with Last.fm and YouTube and uses tagclouds to find related artists.
This is a pretty simple web app that shows the current weather with an image taken near user's location.
A Flash hybrid of Flickr and Google Maps. Worldwide photos mapped.
Like TinyUrl.com but for Google Maps, for example http//useamap.com/lotto . You select the tag name. One click to create a map. No login needed. Free. Just launched on 9th October.
Google Maps mashup solving a transit problem: how to reach from one point to another in Moscow. This mashup can trace routes of Moscow city transport and display them on a map and in special view.
This tool shows you restaurant ratings around your location. If you want to go beyond your normal lunch places, this is a great app.
The Whys between follows on the Web. Browser plugin to assist in finding out why people follow the people they do on Twitter.

Exposes the twitter timeline RSS feed via a private link. This helps to tackle problems with the recently enforced Oauth mechanism. Makes use of the feed in other mashups or e.g. archiving in RSS readers possible.
Soccer Shots is a intro-to-soccer provider across the globe. Its messaging system uses the AT&T in-app messaging API.
This service uses Google Street View and the Instagram API to give context to Instagram posts.

Easy WordPress based system that allows you to manage SMS campaigns for yourself or on behalf of your clients. You can also allow clients to send their own messages via the accompanying SMS Butler plugin.
A twitter search engine powered by tweets to research prices
Site developed to share walking and running routes.

OggChat is a live chat solution for website support and sales that integrates with Google Talk and GMail. It incorporates features such as custom chat windows and skills based routing, but routes all chats directly to each operator's Google Talk acc
A musical mashup of Daft Punk songs. This mashup uses the SoundCloud API.
Search map for internet TV news channels. Separate listing features adult channels. NSFW, not safe for work.
A ThinkUp-powered dashboard tracking 125 federal government agencies on Twitter. We rank which federal agencies are doing the best job of engaging their audiences on social media through Twitter.

An application that uses Flash to explore Flickr photos via virtual 3D planetary systems. Enter a tag, and the related galaxy appears on screen. When you click on a sun, the images are placed on a 3D rotating globe.
Generate video playlists of YouTube videos related to your search term and watch the videos back to back. Embed a playlist in your blog.

Drawloop lets you merge and automate document creation. The service increases sales efficiency, improve close rates and increase revenue by allowing sales reps to create dynamic document packages or DDPs (bundle of Excel, Word, PowerPoint and PDF files).

A Virtual Earth ajax client for locating Gym Alliance fitness clubs. Has search, direction control, the table updates when you mouse-over the club pushpins. If you click through to a specific club, it also provides driving directions.

Facebook's #1 E-Commerce Solution Launch a storefront on your User profile or Facebook page with Muncom's Facebook e-commerce solution. Muncom's Facebook app gives you everything you need to manage your storefront, products and sales.
Provides an alert via Twitter when new schools in your interest area have needs. The DC stands for DonorsChoose, a platform for aggregating non-profit needs.
A rich, interactive map with the current conditions from thousands of locations worldwide.
Enter your words. The most popular in Twitter will win. Twitwinner compares your words based on live data and shows the results in a visual way.
Vreetings is a video-plus-greetings service for creating video greeting cards using a drag-and-drop technique. The videos that you drag are YouTube videos.
Outbreak Watch provides real-time disease metrics based on social network interest.
Love your town!
